title: Modeling human hepatic steatosis in pluripotent stem cell-derived hepatocytes
author: Sinton, Meseguer-Ripolles, et al.

steps.title: Prepare stem cell media
steps.instruction: Add 100 mL mTeSR1™ 5X supplement to 400 mL mTeSR1™ basal medium; store up to 1 month at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare differentiation media
steps.instruction: Make the three differentiation media formulations as described.

substeps.instruction: Endoderm differentiation medium: add 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin and 1× B27 supplement to 500 mL RPMI‑1640; store up to 1 month at 4 °C.

Hepatic progenitor differentiation medium: mix 400 mL KO‑DMEM, 100 mL KOSR serum replacement, 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin, 1 % DMSO, 1 % non‑essential amino acids, 0.5 % Glutamax, and 0.2 % β‑mercaptoethanol; store up to 1 month at 4 °C.

Hepatocyte maturation medium: add 1 % Glutamax, 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin, 20 ng/mL hepatocyte growth factor, 10 ng/mL oncostatin M, and 10 µM hydrocortisone 21‑hemisuccinate sodium salt to HepatoZYME medium; store up to 1 month at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare growth factor stocks
steps.instruction: Create 1,000× stock solutions for activin A, Wnt3A, hydrocortisone, HGF, OSM, and ROCK inhibitor Y‑27632, aliquot and store as specified.

substeps.instruction: Activin A: dissolve lyophilized protein in sterile 0.2 % BSA/DPBS to 100 µg/mL; aliquot 30 µL; store at –20 °C; use 1:1000 dilution.
Wnt3A: dissolve lyophilized mouse Wnt3A in sterile 0.2 % BSA/DPBS to 10 µg/mL; aliquot 30 µL; store at –20 °C; use 1:200 dilution.
Hydrocortisone 21‑hemisuccinate (HCC): dissolve in DPBS to 10 µM; sterile‑filter with a 22 µm filter; store 5 mL aliquots at –20 °C; use 1:100 dilution.
HGF: dissolve lyophilized HGF in sterile BSA/DPBS to 10 µg/mL; aliquot 30 µL; store at –20 °C; use 1:1000 dilution.
OSM: dissolve lyophilized oncostatin M in sterile BSA/DPBS to 20 µg/mL; aliquot 30 µL; store at –20 °C; use 1:1000 dilution.
ROCK inhibitor Y‑27632: dissolve in sterile 0.2 % BSA/DPBS to 10 mM; aliquot 10 µL; store at –20 °C; use 1:1000 dilution.

steps.title: Prepare steatosis components (24 h prior)
steps.instruction: Make stock solutions of lactate, pyruvate, and octanoic acid for the steatosis induction cocktail.

substeps.instruction: Sodium L‑lactate: dissolve in DPBS to 1 M; sterile‑filter with a 22 µm filter; store 1 mL aliquots at –20 °C for up to 1 week.
Sodium pyruvate: dissolve in DPBS to 100 mM; sterile‑filter with a 22 µm filter; store 1 mL aliquots at –20 °C for up to 1 week.

Octanoic acid: dissolve lyophilized octanoic acid in sterile de‑ionized water to 100 mM; adjust pH to 7.0–7.9 with 4 M NaOH while stirring until clear; store 1 mL aliquots at –20 °C for up to 1 week. CRITICAL: compounds stored >1 week lose effectiveness and must be discarded.

steps.title: Prepare steatosis induction cocktail
steps.instruction: Add lactate, pyruvate, and octanoic acid to HepatoZYME medium to final concentrations of 10 mM, 1 mM, and 2 mM respectively; sterile‑filter the solution prior to use.

steps.title: Passage hPSCs for differentiation
steps.instruction: Passage human pluripotent stem cells to obtain a single‑cell suspension and seed at the appropriate density for hepatocyte differentiation.

substeps.instruction: When hPSCs reach 75 %–80 % confluence, aspirate the culture medium.
Wash each well with 18 °C–25 °C 1× DPBS (Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free) and aspirate.
Add 1 mL Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent to each well; incubate at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ for 5–8 min.
While cells dissociate, prepare Laminin‑521‑coated plates; carefully aspirate excess Laminin‑521 without disturbing the coating. CRITICAL: Do not let the coating dry.
Immediately after aspirating, add 1 mL supplemented mTeSR1 pre‑warmed to 37 °C containing 10 µM ROCK inhibitor Y‑27632 to each well of a 6‑well plate (half the final media volume).
Incubate the Laminin‑521 plates with ROCK‑supplemented media at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ until cells are ready for plating.
Examine cells under a light microscope; if cells are not yet single‑cell suspensions, extend incubation up to a maximum of 10 min (cells appear round as edges detach).
Aspirate the Gentle Cell Dissociation Reagent and immediately add 1 mL pre‑warmed supplemented mTeSR1 with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor to each well.
Detach cells by gently scraping with a cell scraper.
Collect the cell‑containing media into a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min at 18 °C–25 °C.
Aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the pellet; tap the tube to break any clumps.

Add 10 mL supplemented mTeSR1 with 10 µM ROCK inhibitor; slowly pipette up and down to resuspend. Count cells with an automatic counter using Trypan Blue to exclude dead cells; perform three counts and calculate the mean.
Seed cells at 5.0 × 10⁴ cells cm⁻² of growth surface (optimize density for different well formats if needed).
Place the plate on a flat surface and gently shake up‑and‑down, then left‑to‑right, ten times each.
Incubate the seeded hPSCs at 37 °C/5 % CO₂ for 24 h before initiating the differentiation protocol.
